response.description: The Archive access tier for Azure Blob Storage is now generally available in the Taiwan North region.With this regional expansion, customers in Taiwan can now store infrequently accessed data in the cost-effective Archive tier, while meeting data residency and compliance requirements locally. The Archive tier is ideal for long-term backup, compliance, and archival scenarios, offering the lowest-priced storage option in Azure.You can manage Archive tier data using the Azure portal, CLI, PowerShell, or REST API. This update brings Taiwan North in line with other regions that support the full range of Azure Blob Storage tiers: Hot, Cool, Cold, and Archive.
response.title: Generally Available: The Archive access tier for Azure Blob Storage is now generally available in the Taiwan North region
